create_FourierDataset: create a FourierDataset from a training dataset to compute per-view ray statistics and FFT of RGB images
create_FourierLightfieldDataset: create a FourierLightfieldDataset from a training dataset for lightfield-based ray sampling with FFT features
use_fft_rgb: apply a 2D FFT transform to each RGB channel of a tensor using ortho normalization
use_FourierDataset_get_random_rays: generate random rays with randomized position and direction for a FourierDataset within a given ray range
use_FourierLightfieldDataset_get_random_: generate random lightfield rays from a randomized 2D position using the get_lightfield_rays utility
